shared_elements: horizontal row of repeated rounded/bag-like motifs in an upper register
division of the surface into stacked registers/panels
curved or hooked linear motif (possible serpentine element)
justification: The most specific correspondence is the band of repeated rounded, bag- or arch-like motifs running horizontally across the top of both surfaces, with larger profile animal forms in a register beneath, suggesting a comparable register-based scheme. The biggest difference is the physical presentation and finish: A is a single crisply carved pale upright slab with legible outlines and shallow modelling, whereas B is a group of coarse dark blocks whose carving is so eroded and lichen-covered that the motifs are barely resolvable, so the apparent similarity may partly be a product of that ambiguity.
